title: 2019 AMC 12B Problem 4
statement: A positive integer \(n\) satisfies the equation \((n+1)!+(n+2)!=440\cdot n!.\) What is the sum of the digits of \(n?\)

solutions.text:
Factor the left side: \[ \begin{gathered} (n+1)!+(n+2)! \\ =(n+1)!\,[1+(n+2)] \\ =(n+1)!\,(n+3). \end{gathered} \]

Dividing both sides by \(n!\) and using \((n+1)!=(n+1)\,n!\) gives \[ (n+1)(n+3)=440. \]

So \(n^2+4n-437=0,\) which factors as \((n-19)(n+23)=0,\) giving \(n=19.\) Its digit sum is \(1+9=10.\)

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Factor \((n+1)!\) out of the left side
